messages:
maria.partnerships: Heads-up — Snowflake + Qdrant field pilot goes live next Tue. We only have a small GPU pool for the pilot and ops warned capacity could be tight. Need a quick, low-risk queueing/backpressure plan so partner demos don't hit OOM or huge tail latency. 

sam.eng: Agreed. We should throttle at the connector ingress layer and prefer batching + tail-cutoff over dropping. Can we add a per-tenant inflight cap and a soft queue with token-bucket shaping? @jason-platops any infra constraints? :thinking_face: 

jason-platops: Infra: limited GPU headroom for the pilot region this week. We can spin a tiny burst pool but it's costly. Recommend two-lane routing: 
- lane A: low-latency requests (max_inflight=32, fast-path model) 
- lane B: best-effort batch (max_inflight=128, batched quantized model) 
Use a queue length cap and expose a Retry-After header for callers. 

neha-ml: From model side, ensure KV cache warming is preserved for lane A (short sequences). For lane B, increase batch_window_ms to 80-120ms to hit higher throughput. Also add a quality guard: if batch size > X and avg perplexity delta > threshold, route to lane A. 

sam.eng: Draft connector config snippet (testing):
```
# connector backpressure config
backpressure.enabled=true
backpressure.max_inflight_per_tenant=64
backpressure.soft_queue_limit=256
backpressure.batch_window_ms=100
backpressure.drop_policy=tail_cutoff
backpressure.retry_after_secs=10
route.laneA.model_variant=redwood-fast-1
route.laneB.model_variant=redwood-quant-1
```
We should ship this as a runtime flag so partners can opt-in during the pilot. Thoughts? 

rosa-cs: Customer-facing note: if we return Retry-After, partner SDKs should surface it gracefully so demos don't show errors. Can we have a default friendly message and telemetry tag so CS can filter pilot demo errors? :pray: 

jason-platops: We'll add metrics: inflight_per_tenant, queue_depth, dropped_requests, avg_latency_laneA, avg_latency_laneB. Wire these to the partnership dashboard with 1s granularity for the pilot. Also add an alert when queue_depth > 200 for 30s. 

neha-ml: Small ML caveat — batched quantized variant sometimes regresses on short prompt tasks. Add an eval gate: run 1-per-minute smoke eval on a fixed prompt set; if quality regress > 2% then temporarily move traffic to lane A and alert SRE + ML. 

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: CI/CD: rolling config update started for connector-backpressure v2 -> 6 hosts updated, 0 failures. (pipeline: connectors/rollouts) :rocket: 

sam.eng: Owner checklist for pilot: 
- sam.eng: implement runtime flags + telemetry (today)
- jason-platops: dashboard + alerts (EOD)
- neha-ml: eval smoke tests + gate (EOD)
- rosa-cs: partner comm copy + SDK hint (tomorrow morning)
- maria.partnerships: communicate fallbacks to SI and demo schedule (tomorrow)

maria.partnerships: Perfect. Let's use this config as the default for pilot tenants. I'll ping the SI lead with the Retry-After guidance and ask them to add fallback UI. Closing action: meet 09:30 PDT Monday to sanity-check dashboards. @everyone please add any missing items here. :white_check_mark:
